purpose: Sketch of a series of translators (decision 2 of .steering/20261028-multilingual-survey): three English translations of 'The Little Mermaid' by Andersen, each cut into the same number of equal runs of tokens so that tile k of every translation stands at the same place in the story, every tile under the common height scale and one seed (the same lens for every translator). Images only; whether this replaces or joins work 2 is decided after the researcher has seen them.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-28 and committed before the script was run. Seen before: the three texts (their openings and endings), the count of NRC matches only (sentences 331, 407, 360; paragraphs 61, 104, 103; matched share of tokens 0.66 in all three; scratchpad coverage.py, decision 3 of .steering/20261028-multilingual-survey). Not seen before: any valence or arousal value of these texts, any tile. The unit (equal runs of tokens, N = 60) was chosen by the researcher on 2026-10-28 (AskUserQuestion) because sentences and paragraphs differ between the translators. Changed after the review before running (no high finding): ties in the ranks, the dropped captions as strings and the last line fixed, the matching inside a run stated.

translations.heading: THE LITTLE MERMAID

steps: works/sketch_translations.extract_body (non-empty stripped lines after the last line equal to the heading; a line whose letters are all upper case is an illustration caption, dropped and listed), atact.lexicon.tokenize of the kept lines joined by one space, cut into N runs at k T // N, atact.lexicon.match_terms per run and the mean of V and A of the matched terms (a run with no match is (0, 0) and flagged), src/relief.tile and relief.grey of H under the common scale. A multiword entry of the lexicon is matched only inside a run (sentence boundaries are not seen). Checked before running without the lexicon: no kept line ends with a hyphen in any translation; the last kept line of each is the closing sentence of the story (its SHA-256 is fixed below).

lexicon.name: NRC VAD Lexicon v2.1
lexicon.terms: non-commercial research and education only; not redistributed

relief_source: the values of work 1 (works/conditions/work1.json): the same rule, scale, eps and seed

figure.order: panels left to right in the order of translations; tiles in reading order, six to a row (ten rows), origin of each tile lower left; no labels in the images

reported: per translation the dropped captions, the unmatched runs and the number of matched terms per run (minimum and median); the Spearman correlation (tied values given the mean of their ranks) by position of V and of A between each pair of translations, as a description only
not_claimed: Nothing about the emotion of the story or of a translation: each point is the mean of dictionary values of the matched terms of a run. The correlations are not a test and are not used to choose anything. Differences between the panels come from the words of the translations under one lexicon and one rule; the lexicon, the unit and the scale are the makers' quantities.
